_schema.note: Weapons, technologies and important items. 'game_item' names the WeaponBuilder / enemy feature that represents it.

entries.name: Gambit
entries.description: Wemmbu's signature Density-enchanted mace and the most iconic weapon in the Unstable Universe. Enchantments: Density V, Mending, Unbreaking III, Fire Aspect II, Wind Burst II.
entries.history: Descended from the mace Yeah_Jaron gave Wemmbu; changed hands (Flame, ClownPierce, FerreMC) before Wemmbu won it back.
entries.gameplay_note: Hero Wemmbu's melee weapon; Wind Burst knockback is a GAME MECHANIC inspired by the enchantment.

entries.name: Crucible
entries.description: Wemmbu's Breach-enchanted mace.

entries.name: Maces (general)
entries.description: Deal more damage the farther the user falls before impact; extremely powerful. Rare because the Invisible Mafia destroyed every reachable ominous spawner except those in the Far Lands. Wemmbu holds two of the remaining maces.
entries.gameplay_note: Mace users deal bonus damage after 'drops' (elevated build zones).

entries.name: Orbital Strike Cannon
entries.description: Build designed by cubicmetre that drops hundreds of TNT on a chosen location. Works by duplicating TNT in lazy chunks (chunks at the edge of loaded area that process redstone but not entities) where it stays in stasis and accumulates momentum, then loading it. Coordinates are written in a book in a Nether control room and delivered via chest minecart. Has nuke shots and stab shots. In the series it is replicated with a carpet-mod script.
entries.history: Used against Zam; against ShoeBilly (stab shots); at the Battle for Capital City (a nuke killed hundreds of innocents and thousands of soldiers).
entries.gameplay_note: Hero Wemmbu: Stab Shot (active) and Nuke Shot (ultimate). Ally-tower version for Wemmbu-as-tower.

entries.name: Redstone Blimp
entries.description: Cindercrest's airship used to drop slow-falling paratroopers into Fort Feather when the ground assault failed.
entries.gameplay_note: Boss phase 3: the blimp crosses the map dropping paratroopers; it can be shot down.

entries.name: TNT minecarts (carting)
entries.description: Cart PvP: terrain-based TNT minecart combat relying on timing and foot placement. Theo's signature; used to win the Warriors Council contest, kill a Law commander and wipe out Cindercrest players.
entries.gameplay_note: Theo tower fires TNT minecart barrages.

entries.name: TNT cannons
entries.description: Built by Lomedy to bombard the toxic base.

entries.name: Totem of Undying
entries.description: Wemmbu was left one Totem and a Golden Apple in Arachnid's pit; Totems are central to survival in the series.
entries.gameplay_note: Totem Carrier enemies revive once; Wemmbu's clutch passive.

entries.name: Totem of NULL
entries.description: Taken from JamatoP; symbol of NULL leadership.

entries.name: Wind charges
entries.description: Spoke wind-charged Mapicc into the void.
entries.gameplay_note: Spoke trap: knock enemies back along the path.

entries.name: Elytra
entries.description: Elytras are common mobility tools; Wemmbu saved his elytra; The Wraith fights with trident, mace and elytra.

entries.name: Withers
entries.description: Withers infested spawn; Theo saved Parrot from two of them. The Far Lands sorting test required killing a wither with five items.

entries.name: Wardens
entries.description: Wemmbu accidentally unleashed wardens on the Kingdom of the Caves' mines.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.description: Hallmark of the Invisible Mafia; Spoke also operated invisibly.

entries.name: Ender pearl network
entries.description: The Mafia transported pearls (stasis) — the protagonists broke into the spawn prison to find where.

entries.name: Bottles of enchanting
entries.description: Currency of the Egg Civilization.
entries.gameplay_note: Meta currency 'XP Bottles' and Eggchan's income tower.

entries.name: Spears
entries.description: The wiki has a Spears page; specifics were not recovered.

entries.name: Beacons
entries.description: Used by resistance cells to signal each other.

entries.name: Slow Falling potions
entries.description: Used by blimp paratroopers.
entries.gameplay_note: Paratrooper enemies descend from the blimp.

entries.name: Cobwebs
entries.description: Wemmbu trapped ShoeBilly in webs; the Spider Web Faction theme.
